map.由弹性模量与泊松比求拉梅常数 使用指南: Lame Constant from Elastic Modulus and Poisson's Ratio User Guide
map.输入弹性模量E与泊松比ν，按 λ = Eν/[(1+ν)(1−2ν)] 计算拉梅: Enter elastic modulus E and Poisson's ratio ν and compute the first Lame constant as λ = Eν/[(1+ν)(1−2ν)], for elastic mechanics constitutive analysis.
map.λ = Eν/[(1+ν)(1−2ν)]。 钢 E=200GPa,ν=0.3 →: λ = Eν/[(1+ν)(1−2ν)]. Steel E = 200 GPa, ν = 0.3 -> about 115 GPa.
map.输入弹性模量 E 与泊松比 ν，求拉梅常数 λ。: Enter elastic modulus E and Poisson's ratio ν to get the Lame constant λ.
map.：lambda = E*nu/((1+nu)*(1-2nu))，与剪切模量 G: : lambda = E*nu/((1+nu)*(1−2nu)); together with the shear modulus G it forms the isotropic constitutive law sigma = lambda*tr(epsilon)*I + 2G*epsilon.
map.：lambda 反映体积响应成分，G 反映形状响应；两者比由 nu 决定。: : lambda reflects the volumetric response component and G the shape response; their ratio is set by nu.
map.λ 和 K 什么关系？: How are λ and K related?
map.K = lambda + 2G/3，二者都描述体积刚度但表达体系不同（拉梅体系用: K = lambda + 2G/3; both describe volumetric stiffness but in different systems (Lame uses λ,G, engineering usually E,nu).
map.为什么有限元爱用 λ,G？: Why does finite element work prefer λ,G?
map.三维本构直接以 λ,G 写最简洁，编程实现方便；前处理再由 E,nu 换算。: The three-dimensional constitutive law is most compact written directly in λ,G, easy to implement in code; preprocessing then converts from E,nu.
